name: Teen Volunteer Program
what_you_do: Teens volunteer for seven weeks in summer, working two four-hour shifts a week. The hospital does not offer shadowing or internships to teens.
who_can_apply: Age 16 or older and currently in grades 10 to 12. Needs a physician form, reference forms and a free urine drug screen.
duration: 7 weeks, July 6 to Aug 21 in 2026. Two 4-hour shifts a week.
deadline_text: The page says the 2026 window is closed and to check again in February 2027 for summer 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Volunteer Interest Form and do a short interview. Then finish a longer application. It needs a counselor reference, a personal reference, a doctor form and a drug test. Then do the online and in-person orientation.
notes: Full attendance is expected without exception. Phones are not allowed on shifts. Parents cannot send the application for the teen.
